fields.notes: Bosch CAN 2.0 (1991) is a wire-level protocol spec; no confidentiality / integrity / authentication features. CAN is broadcast — every node sees every frame. Built-in security primitive is the 15-bit CRC (anti-corruption only, not anti-tampering). Modern automotive security (CAN-FD MAC, SecOC, AUTOSAR SecOC profile) is layered on top — not part of Bosch CAN 2.0.
